_comment: Authoritative dispatched-operation lists per service MODULE, verified against the ministack runtime dispatch tables as of 1.4.10. Loaded and merged into the catalog by build_catalog.py, overriding the heuristic AST scraper (which mis-scrapes struct field names, enum values, service-integration action tokens, and docstring prose as operations). Same verification as ministack-dev/tools/ops_pins.json but keyed by module rather than doc section. Empty list = no dispatched SDK operations (pipes is CloudFormation-only; _dynamodb_keywords is an internal helper).
